//Urls: Health only, on an internal interface. NOT behind nginx: there is nothing here a caller should reach from outside, and the details name paths on this host.

ConnectionStrings.//Jobs: Every delivery is a row, so a worker restarting mid-upload does not lose one.

Intune.//: The fallback for a workspace with no settings of its own. Per-workspace settings live in the workspace_settings table and are set through PUT /workspaces/{id}/settings/intune.
Intune.//ClientSecret: Deprecated. Put the secret in the APPDELIVERY_INTUNE_SECRET_<workspaceid> environment variable on the worker instead — a deploy overwrites this file and takes anything here with it.
Intune.//SecretExpiresOn: Warned about 30 days ahead, once a day. Nothing else warns you: on the day it lapses every delivery fails with a 401 that does not mention expiry.

Packaging.//IntuneWinAppUtil: Microsoft's tool, from github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Win32-Content-Prep-Tool. The worker has to have it.
Packaging.//WorkFolder: A job needs about three times the size of the application. Put this on a data disk, not the system drive.
Packaging.//TimeoutMinutes: A multi-gigabyte suite is compressed and encrypted byte by byte.
Packaging.//KeepFailedDays: How long a failed delivery's work folder is kept. It is the only evidence of what went wrong, and after a month it is ten gigabytes nobody will open.

Signing.//: Off by default. The wrapper is already inside a package only Intune can open, and a certificate is a thing to look after.
Signing.//CertificateThumbprint: Preferred: the certificate lives in the machine store and its private key is never a file.
Signing.//PfxPath: The alternative. Its password is read from the APPDELIVERY_SIGNING_PASSWORD environment variable, never from here — a deploy overwrites this file.
Signing.//TimestampUrl: Without it, every machine stops trusting the script on the day the certificate expires.

Testing.//Enabled: Off publishes without installing anywhere first, for an installation with no test machine. The worker warns each time.
Testing.//TimeoutMinutes: Reverting a snapshot, booting, installing a suite, removing it and reverting again.

//Crawler: How long to wait for a crawler to sign in and download. Long: this covers a multi-gigabyte download over a vendor's own link.
//Suggestions: Fills in what could not be read from the installer - mostly the silent switch for an .exe. Off by default. The key is read from APPDELIVERY_OPENAI_KEY in the environment, never from here. A suggested value only ships if testing is on: the test machine is what proves a guess.
